name: RigoBlock Drago setMultipleAllowances missing owner check
summary: Drago v2 pools expose setMultipleAllowances(proxy, tokens, amounts) without the onlyOwner and whenApprovedProxy modifiers that guard setAllowance, so anyone can make a pool approve an arbitrary spender for its ERC-20 holdings. The attacker had the Pure Alpha Drago approve its contract for six tokens and then pulled and sold them; a second actor later used the same call on the byte-identical PayRue 1 Drago to take its aDAI.

loss.notes: Exact Drago debits: Pure Alpha 0x682e3e207b18555bc75c072233e7d9fd0c386b9a lost six tokens in source-2 (block 14224068), and PayRue 1 0x98901ce9c337c8663e49a8ba2bc36370990d5e6e lost 78.459636476125759114 aDAI (including interest accrued on transfer) in source-6. Source-2 was sent by generalized front-runner 0x7eb44bf215794d5a44d44b2d8d4a32da2a7a5aea, which replayed the attacker contract's public drain function; the attacker's own copy (0x3ea9d22cda4e34f8fb73b3a79f84be174f2af459d46322e6d5e7903259696bf8) reverted, and the proceeds still went to the attacker contract. Reported whitehat returns and the bounty do not reduce gross loss. Reported totals (SlowMist 160.86 ETH, DefiLlama 464,000 USD) are not reproduced by any Drago debit found; they appear to describe value at risk.

ageReset.description: DragoFactory v2 created the Pure Alpha Drago with the full Drago runtime (no delegation for setMultipleAllowances); the runtime is immutable and owner operations do not affect the missing modifiers. PayRue 1 is a byte-identical sibling exploited later in the same episode.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. Verified Drago source (source-5): setAllowance is onlyOwner whenApprovedProxy, while setMultipleAllowances(address,address[],uint256[]) (selector 0xc67f72e1) has neither and calls setAllowancesInternal -> Token(_token).approve(_tokenTransferProxy, _amount) for each token. RigoBlock's fix, rigoblock-monorepo commit 72bd6acb09bec09e2825b28d300b2e3d4488308f ('multiple allowance bugfix'), adds exactly onlyOwner and whenApprovedProxy to packages/contracts/src/protocol/Drago/Drago.sol. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 14224067, index 206): EOA 0x7e92dbf1be21bffa36f38ad59325c797c2c68f3e calls its contract 0x71b77d2b0606f85ddc174a82172fc99b4f33d93d (created at block 14224059), which calls Pure Alpha.setMultipleAllowances(0x71b77d2b..., [ZRX, LRC, WETH, UNI, ENS, HBOT], ...); receipt Approval logs 0x1e3..0x1e8 name spender 0x71b77d2b.... eth_call owner() at block 14224066 is 0xca9f5049c1ea8fc78574f94b7cf5be5fee354c31, not the caller. Source-2 (block 14224068) then transferFroms the six tokens to 0x71b77d2b... and swaps them on UniswapV2Router02. Drago set: DragoRegistry v2 0xde6445484a8dcd9bf35fc95eb4e3990cc358822e (Parity registry 0xe3389675d0338462dc76c6f9a3e432550c36a142 getAddress(keccak256('dragoregistry-v2'),'A')) has dragoCount 40 at block 14225000; fromId(i) gives each address and owner. Earliest-use scan: Etherscan V2 logs Approval(owner = Drago) for all 40 pools, blocks 0..14224066, returns 55 logs in 33 transactions; for every transaction touching a Drago, tx.from equals owner() at the previous block (the other senders, 0x0002b44ddb1476db43c868bd494422ee4c136fed at blocks 9533778..9533896, called a different selector 0x0d5f3f54 on Vault contracts). Blocks 14150000..14240000 add only Pure Alpha (source-1), PayRue 1 by non-owner 0x7fc9da70397a5cc8c0c2ec09bd259fbc40bf1a88 (0x566c4751896e7152cf74a64fda318230245af4d41596674721711c35d43a13c1, block 14226642; owner 0xa9e81167b02cc4a79e100e3e0af8f6cd97cc2727), owner operations on Aquant, and a post-incident call on Next Generation D by RigoBlock's own address at block 14235357 that moved no funds to a third party. Identity/age: eth_getCode empty at block 8975439; keccak256 of runtime 0xa8d69ecad62153eb6c5623d40107961f622d9c76d88f80604187ebae2c87d4bc at 8975440 and 14224066, identical for PayRue 1, Aquant and Next Generation D at 14224066. Creation tx source-14 (index 124) is a DragoFactory v2 0x6000f8fd5db35e17b4e25cba72933165708fbf86 call by 0xca9f5049...; Etherscan getcontractcreation names the factory. The source has DELEGATECALL only in owner-gated operateOnExchange and no selfdestruct; the trace shows setMultipleAllowances executing in the Drago's own runtime. Deployment supplies the age.

Reviewed loss from receipts. Source-2 receipt Transfer logs from Pure Alpha to 0x71b77d2b...: ZRX 33833685424035854903238, LRC 7592265052786943590400, WETH 1812552787359242252, UNI 500000000000000000000, ENS 200000000000000000000, HBOT 36811111589919355343784 base units (all 18 decimals). Etherscan V2 logs Transfer(from = Pure Alpha), blocks 14200000..14300000, show no other outflow after the exploit (the only earlier one is an owner GRG transfer at block 14203197). Source-6 (block 14226660, index 39): transferFrom(PayRue 1 -> 0x7fc9da70...) moves 78459636476125759114 aDAI to the attacker (70171870958223982204 from the recorded balance plus 8287765517901776910 accrued interest minted on transfer); the approved AMPL was not taken. Prices: DefiLlama historical quotes at the Pure Alpha drain time 1645106561 (source-7..12) and at the PayRue drain 1645141003 (source-13).

Verified Drago source at https://etherscan.io/address/0x682e3e207b18555bc75c072233e7d9fd0c386b9a#code; reproduce Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=1. ContractName Drago, compiler v0.4.25+commit.59dbf8f1, optimizer 200 runs. SHA-256 of returned SourceCode: 61fd3fb2d6c06c3c72be392bfc1afed92bbfd508f19d091498aa43f4f4e5fb3b. Inspect setAllowance, setMultipleAllowances, setAllowancesInternal and onlyOwner.
